summary: Master solid waste storage management. Learn ISWA standards, smart bin technology, and transfer station design to optimize urban waste systems. Register now.
lede: Solid waste storage planning training is for waste infrastructure professionals who assess capacity and design containment systems. Participants learn to characterize waste streams, forecast generation and calculate storage requirements, then plan containers and transfer-station workflows. They also practice mapping bin placement and collection routes with GIS, applying RFID tracking, and preparing containment plans for hazardous waste.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals tasked with the design, oversight, and optimization of waste infrastructure in municipal and industrial settings.
modules: Foundations of Integrated Solid Waste Storage
Design and Management of Transfer Stations
Smart Waste Storage and Digital Integration
Special and Hazardous Waste Storage Protocols
Financial Planning and Life Cycle Costing
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in waste management, urban planning, or environmental services. Basic familiarity with environmental regulations and spreadsheet-based data analysis is recommended to fully engage with the technical modeling exercises.
